title: [CLOSED] FREE iTunes and Amazon Gift Card Code Giveaway INFO
description: Comments on this video will NOT count towards the giveaway. You may subscribe now if you wish.

asr.full_text: Hey YouTube, what's up? It's KT93 here, and today I'm going to be doing a little bit of something special for you guys today. Although this won't be the official video for what I'm about to tell you guys, I'm pretty sure from the title you can probably guess what I'm going to talk about. So, recently I got two gift cards, and I figured that I'm not really going to be using the money, so instead of just kind of leaving it there to sit, I'm going to give it away to you guys. Now for Christmas one of my teachers gave me a gift card for Amazon and if you can't read it. It's ten dollars I'll try to get a better shot of that if you can't read that but um there is a code. Here I'm not showing it so you can't steal it obviously but I have a ten dollar gift card for. Amazon and I also have ten dollars uh with iTunes credit that I'm going to give away which I don't. Have the physical card I just got it I won that in a giveaway so I'm just going to like re-gift. It, I guess. So basically how this is going to work is that this giveaway is going to start once. I hit 1,500 subscribers. And right now I have around 1,250 some odd subscribers. So that's. Only about 250 to go. I don't think I'll have a problem getting up to 1,500 in a short period of. Time. So once I hit 1,500 subscribers, I'm going to post two different giveaways, one for the Amazon,. One for the iTunes gift card giveaway. And I guess I'll have to prove to you guys. I actually have the iTunes money,. Which I'll do a little bit later. But yeah, so that's how it's going to work. And then when I'm actually going to announce the winners. Is actually when I hit 2,000 subscribers. So I don't think that's very unrealistic. So after I hit 1,500, I should... I'm expecting 500 more subscribers. Until I announce it. When I actually post the videos,. Which I'll be sure to let you guys know,. Is that I'm going to have you guys subscribe to my channel, obviously,. And I'm going to have you guys only allowed to leave one comment,. And that's for ease on my part so that everyone pretty much has a fair shot. It's just once and done. You don't have to really worry about it,. And I don't have to go counting to make sure,. Oh, this person entered once a day or something like that. So it's going to be pretty simple. Unfortunately, I can't really be doing giveaways all the time. Because I don't really have much money and stuff to give away. I don't have many products to give away. Plus, I don't have time to go to the post office and go ship them. So, that's basically how it's going to work. Expect that within the next, I don't know, however long it takes me to get the 1,500 subs. But until then, this is KT93 here, and I'll see you guys later.
